en: Color postcard showing a dramatic alpine lake whose shoreline water appears bright red, with forested slopes and rocky mountain peaks in the background. A lone person stands on the grassy shore looking at the lake. On the right side, there is a white margin with printed Italian text and a small scientific-style illustration of a green cell-like sphere filled with red dots, representing the organism causing the lake's reddening.
